propositions: Contributor and agent guidance must use each contributor's configured real DCO identity; Joe Oakhart's bot identity should only appear in explicitly automated workflows.
The force flag bypasses all gates including future gates, but ticket-system invariants such as the open-children close prohibition remain non-bypassable.
LLM verification must preserve provider-independent parsing and self-healing while rejecting semantically empty results as valid review outcomes.
Plan review cannot produce a clean pass when ticket hierarchy was loaded incompletely unless the omitted context is demonstrably irrelevant.
ChatGPT-specific guidance is needed for safe Rebar usage when the GitHub repository is a read-only mirror with no native clone, Gerrit, or tracker access available.
